test_types.description: List of test types to enable or disable; each item defines a test category and its flag/behavior. Must include at least one enabled test for bfbtester to run meaningfully.

test_types.enabled.description: Whether to include the corresponding flag (-s, -m, -e, or -a) in the command line.

test_types.flag.description: Command-line flag character: 's', 'm', 'e', or 'a' for single/multi/env/all tests.

test_types.description.description: Human-readable description of the test type, used for comments in the config.

tempfile_monitor.description: Whether to enable tempfile creation monitoring (-t).

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level; valid values are integers 0, 1, or 2 (inclusive).

max_execs.description: Maximum number of executables to run in parallel. Must be ≥ 1.

skip_binaries.description: List of binary names (not paths) to skip when scanning directories (i.e., used with -r).

output_file.description: Path to write output instead of stdout (used with -o). Empty string disables output redirection.

targets.description: List of binaries (absolute or relative paths) or directories to test. Directories are scanned one level deep.
